title: Abdullah_Short1_95% of entrepreneurs are wrong about this_2026-08-01
description: Abdullah_Short1_95% of entrepreneurs are wrong about this_2026-08-01
transcript: In my experience, what I'll do is like, let's say we do something and it's working really well. We start to get a lot of calls or start to get a lot of sales. I think that it's the adjustment that we did that's helping us scale. But really it was something that we did 60 days ago or 90 days ago. And that's happened once or twice. I'm like, oh, we're getting all these sales because of this thing right here. But in reality, we're getting all these sales because of stuff we did 60 days ago. A lot of people think like, I'm gonna do this thing today and the thing tomorrow is gonna end up being the results of what I did today. But almost always the life that we're living today, the experiences we're having today is from at the minimum 90 days ago decisions that we're making them. And then the life that you're living today is also be from the decisions you made two years ago, three years ago, five years ago.
